photos.title: Romanian Atheneum, Bucharest
photos.author: Alex Siro
photos.changes: EXIF orientation normalized; resized proportionally to a maximum 840 px edge with Lanczos3; converted to WebP; metadata removed. No crop, recolouring, retouching or generated content.
photos.visualReview: Passed: inspected the final WebP; the Athenaeum dome and columned side entrance are visible, not a generic city panorama. Commons monument ID B-II-m-A-18789 also matches the Romanian National Heritage Institute register.

photos.title: National Village Museum, house from Dumitra, Alba
photos.author: Britchi V.I.Iulia
photos.changes: EXIF orientation normalized; resized proportionally to a maximum 840 px edge with Lanczos3; converted to WebP; metadata removed. No crop, recolouring, retouching or generated content.
photos.visualReview: Passed: inspected the final WebP; the thatched-roof Dumitra household exhibit and woven fence are visible. This is one genuine outdoor exhibit at the Village Museum, not its entrance or an entire-museum view.

missing.reason: Held pending clarification of underlying building-rights limitations: Commons search returned Parliament images explicitly redacted for lack of freedom of panorama in Romania. Photographer CC licences alone were not treated as confirmation of all rights.

notes: Each derivative remains under its source CC BY-SA licence; display author, source and licence links and the resize/conversion notice.
These two photographs are visually different and neither reuses the current Bucharest University Square city hero.
No Parliament photo was added, and no generated replacement, collage or colour filter was used.
